items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: And, let's see, Joe Watson. All them clarinets players was playin' at that time.

ctx.x: Remember any clarinets that was with the…

Well, the clarinets they had the Osie Boys and T.U. And, uh, Elisier Ree. And Elisier Ree. Little Cripple Peele, Cripple Peele. And, let's see, Joe Watson. All them clarinets players was playin' at that time.
Do you remember who worked with Chris Kelly? George Boyd.
